LightningComponentBundle.description: Append-only communication tracker (calls/emails/meetings/notes with direction) for LOI, Underwriting, and Contract Review records.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the log card (e.g. Counter History).

property.name: showRevision
property.label: Show Document Revision
property.description: Adds a Document Revision input (for Legal to record the PSA version) and a revision badge on each entry. Use on Contract Review.

property.name: hideMethod
property.label: Hide Method
property.description: Hides the Method (Call/Email/Meeting/Note) picker in the composer and badge on each entry. Turn on for Contract Review.
